record.question: Who discovered Genetic Code?
record.explanation: Khorana is the only listed person who helped decipher the genetic code. The Nobel citation credits Holley, Khorana and Nirenberg jointly for interpretation of the code; do not portray him as its sole discoverer. The first-pass hold merely because collaborators are absent is not necessary for this option set. Historical exam context: 2014-06 (month/year printed). This is the source-era answer; time-sensitive roles, rankings and memberships may have changed. Evidence: https://www.nobelprize.org/prizes/medicine/1968/summary/ Independently checked solution, unofficial. No matching examiner answer key is asserted.
